description: This file defines a class 'ConnectionManagerLifecycleAdapter' that implements lifecycle participation and observation for a 'ConnectionManager' in an Orleans runtime context. It handles start and stop lifecycle events, specifically managing the closure of the connection manager during the stop phase.

classes.name: ConnectionManagerLifecycleAdapter
classes.description: A lifecycle participant and observer that manages the lifecycle of a ConnectionManager within the Orleans runtime, handling start and stop events.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Completes immediately on start; no additional action needed.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles the stop event by asynchronously closing the connection manager.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Registers the adapter as a participant in the lifecycle, subscribing it to the RuntimeInitialize stage for network-related components.
